risks.risk: Unknown condition (working vs faulty) and internal wear; photos can’t show noise, leaks, or gear wear.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (coupler, mounting hardware, seals, sensors) that affect usability.

risks.risk: Unclear specifications (gear ratio, input/output shaft size, mounting pattern).
risks.proof: Ask for the exact gear ratio and dimensions (input/output shaft diameter, length, bolt pattern) or a spec sheet photo.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of any nameplate/sticker/stamped part number on the unit (both sides).
Send a photo showing the input/output shaft ends (splines/coupler) and the mounting bolt pattern.
Send a short video of the unit operating (or a bench test) showing no abnormal noise and no oil leaks.
Confirm what vehicle/machine it came from (make/model/year or industrial motor model) and the gear ratio.
response.reason: From the single photo, the exact identity/spec and whether it matches the seller’s 'motor speed reducer' claim cannot be confirmed, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the part number/spec and condition proof.
